item.title: UConn women’s basketball celebrates overcoming adversity in Senior Day rout of Providence
item.description: None of the UConn women's basketball seniors had their best showings on Senior Day, but the win over Providence meant more than a stat line.

item.title: CT native Tom Noonan, actor renowned for onscreen menace, dies at 74
item.description: Thomas Patrick Noonan was born April 12, 1951, in Greenwich, Connecticut. Recruited to Yale University, he dropped out after his sophomore year

item.title: It’s a quiet box office weekend as ‘GOAT’ edges ‘Wuthering Heights’
item.description: It was a battle of the holdovers at the North American box office this weekend, with the family friendly film “GOAT” edging out the R-rated “Wuthering Heights.”

item.title: Payton Pritchard thriving for Celtics in return to familiar role
item.description: Sixth Man Payton Pritchard is back and better than ever for the Celtics.

item.title: Sewage issues at Steinbrenner Field alter Yankees’ practice plans
item.description: The Yankees had to spend the morning at Himes because wastewater seeped into sections of their clubhouse at GMS on Saturday.

item.title: Do UConn men have the right mentality to win it all? ‘I don’t know,’ Hurley says
item.description: The UConn men's basketball team returned to defensive form in a well-rounded, critical victory at Villanova on Saturday night as regular season nears its end.

item.title: Dom Amore: Proud, emotional day for UConn hockey coach as Thompson, Team USA strike gold
item.description: UConn coach Mike Cavanaugh watched Team USA win the Olympic gold medal, proud Tage Thompson was there, and Johnny Gaudreau was remembered.
